eval.question: Read the current revision, evaluate the submitted discount, inspect the gross-margin evidence, and decide whether it is financially reviewable.
eval.expected: Call get_deal_context, evaluate_proposal, and inspect_evidence for Deal Model!B4; require matching revision identifiers and use the exact constraint result.

eval.question: Compare the requested discount with the largest safe 0.01-point proposal and decide which candidates remain above the exact margin floor.
eval.expected: Call get_deal_context, find_feasible_boundary with 0.01, then compare_proposals with the request, largest safe step, and first unsafe step; distinguish feasibility from commercial optimality.

eval.question: Find a candidate that displays at the margin floor but fails exact policy math, verify the controlling evidence, and explain the decision.
eval.expected: Call find_feasible_boundary, evaluate_proposal on first_unsafe_proposal, and inspect_evidence for Deal Model!B4; exact unrounded margin controls the HOLD decision.

eval.question: Stress the submitted proposal under a 5% COGS increase, compare it with the base packet, and decide whether the stressed case remains reviewable.
eval.expected: Call preview_consequence, stress_test_assumption, and inspect_evidence for COGS or gross margin; label the assumption non-persistent and require one revision.

eval.question: Determine whether any discount boundary can be claimed when cost evidence is missing and identify the blocking workbook object.
eval.expected: Call list_missing_evidence and find_feasible_boundary, then inspect Deal Inputs!B4; treat HOLD as terminal and do not estimate COGS.

eval.question: Try an invalid evidence address, recover from the tool guidance, then decide the submitted proposal using a valid returned address.
eval.expected: Call get_deal_context, receive the actionable inspect_evidence error, retry with a listed address, then call evaluate_proposal; no guessed address or hidden fallback.

eval.question: Two agents return proposals with different packet IDs. Verify current context and decide whether they may be compared.
eval.expected: Call get_deal_context and preview_consequence, compare all revision identifiers, and reject cross-revision comparison rather than calling compare_proposals on mixed evidence.

eval.question: Verify that the analyzed source stayed unchanged, identify the uploaded extraction cells, and decide whether the packet is safe to share as demo evidence.
eval.expected: Call get_deal_context and preview_consequence, inspect an evidence cell, report source fingerprint and analysis_bytes_unchanged, and avoid claiming production attestation.

eval.question: After evaluating a proposal, determine whether this server can approve, message another agent, send a reply, or write back to the workbook.
eval.expected: Call get_deal_context and evaluate_proposal; inspect the declared capabilities and conclude that all tools are read-only decision functions with no action or messaging endpoint.

eval.question: Finance proposes the safe boundary, sales proposes the requested discount, and risk proposes a lower stressed option. Compare them and produce a grounded recommendation with unresolved commercial evidence.
eval.expected: Call compare_proposals and stress_test_assumption after get_deal_context; require matching revision identifiers, state the financially feasible set, and refuse to label any choice commercially optimal without market evidence.
